description: Methodology for Tidal Wetland and Seagrass Restoration is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Restore America's Estuaries; Silvestrum Climate Associates. This document outlines procedures to quantify net greenhouse gas emission reductions and removals resulting from activities implemented to restore tidal wetlands. Such activities include creating and/or managing the conditions required for healthy, sustainable wetland ecosystems. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
